request: Build a small Jac web app with chat rooms. Users join and leave named rooms and send messages to a room. Each room keeps its message log in order and the set of users present. Joining a room delivers its last 20 messages to the new member and announces the join to the others.
acceptance: A message sent to room A reaches every other member of A and no member of room B.
A user who joins after 25 messages receives exactly the last 20, oldest first.
Sending to a room the user has not joined is rejected; leaving twice sends only one 'left' event.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Deliver events through an in-process event bus that tests can subscribe to; no sockets, no network, no background servers.
Keep the logic deterministic: time is passed in, never read from the clock inside the rules.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
